headline: Job seekers block roads in Dhaka over youth development exam leak
summary: The recruitment exam for Assistant Upazila Youth Development Officer was postponed just before it started, sparking protests and road blockades in the capital.
details: Job seekers blocked roads in Motijheel and Manik Mia Avenue in Dhaka after the recruitment exam for Assistant Upazila Youth Development Officer was postponed.
The exam, which was scheduled for Saturday at 11 AM, was cancelled just moments before it was set to begin, leaving candidates frustrated.

The Department of Youth Development stated that the postponement was due to allegations of question paper leaks, noting a partial match between the actual questions and a suspected leak circulating on social media.
The exam was intended for 242 positions across approximately 100 centers in the capital.
Authorities have announced that a new date for the recruitment exam will be be declared within the next two to three days.
caption:
Exam postponed minutes before the start! Job seekers take to the streets of Dhaka to protest a question paper leak.

Job seekers blocked roads in Motijheel and Manik Mia Avenue in Dhaka after the recruitment exam for Assistant Upazila Youth Development Officer was postponed.

The exam, which was scheduled for Saturday at 11 AM, was cancelled just moments before it was set to begin, leaving candidates frustrated.

The Department of Youth Development stated that the postponement was due to allegations of question paper leaks, noting a partial match between the actual questions and a suspected leak circulating on social media.

The exam was intended for 242 positions across approximately 100 centers in the capital.

Authorities have announced that a new date for the recruitment exam will be be declared within the next two to three days.

headline: CNG driver raped and killed 15-year-old schoolgirl in Cumilla
summary: The suspect, Sumon Mia, confessed to the crime after being arrested in Chattogram. He allegedly lured the girl into a secluded area using a shortcut route.
details: A 15-year-old schoolgirl named Tazmin was raped and killed by a CNG-run auto-rickshaw driver named Sumon Mia in Cumilla early Thursday morning.
Police say the suspect allegedly strangulated the victim with a gamcha and raped her before pressing her head into the mud to ensure her death.
Tazmin had hired the driver's vehicle from Paduar Bazar to racecourse for Tk 300 around 12:30 am on Thursday.
The driver allegedly told the girl he would take a shorter route, but instead drove her to a secluded area where he committed the crime.
After the murder, Sumon Mia stole an iPhone from the victim's bag and hid it near a pond in Chapapur before fleeing to Chattogram.
Tazmin's body was recovered from a paddy field beside the Cumilla-Noakhali regional highway in the Jagatpur area of Perul Uttar union.
The victim's father identified the body using a live location that Tazmin had shared with him at 2:52 am.
Sumon Mia was arrested on Friday by police in Chattogram at his brother's house.
caption:
A 15-year-old schoolgirl was raped and killed by a CNG driver in Cumilla after he lured her into a secluded area.

A 15-year-old schoolgirl named Tazmin was raped and killed by a CNG-run auto-rickshaw driver named Sumon Mia in Cumilla early Thursday morning.

Police say the suspect allegedly strangulated the victim with a gamcha and raped her before pressing her head into the mud to ensure her death.

Tazmin had hired the driver's vehicle from Paduar Bazar to racecourse for Tk 300 around 12:30 am on Thursday.

The driver allegedly told the girl he would take a shorter route, but instead drove her to a secluded area where he committed the crime.

After the murder, Sumon Mia stole an iPhone from the victim's bag and hid it near a pond in Chapapur before fleeing to Chattogram.

Tazmin's body was recovered from a paddy field beside the Cumilla-Noakhali regional highway in the Jagatpur area of Perul Uttar union.

The victim's father identified the body using a live location that Tazmin had shared with him at 2:52 am.

Sumon Mia was arrested on Friday by police in Chattogram at his brother's house.
